title.en: The One With the Cancelled Picnic

description.es: Fina hace los preparativos para ir de picnic con Marta. Mientras Fina le habla a Isidro de su pareja, Isidro se siente incómodo, y tienen un desacuerdo al respecto. Fina le dice a Marta que no la dejará pase lo que pase. Como Jaime ha hecho planes con Marta, el picnic se cancela.
description.en: Fina makes preparations to go on a picnic with Marta. As Fina talks to Isidro about her partner, Isidro grows uncomfortable, and they have a disagreement about it. Fina tells Marta that she will not leave her no matter what. Because Jaime has made plans with Marta, the picnic is cancelled.
